#include <iostream>
#include <map>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n, b;
    std::cin >> n >> b;
    int* a = new int[n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }

    std::map<int, int> costs;
    int odd = 0;
    int even = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) {
            even++;
        } else {
            odd++;
        }
        if (odd == even) {
            int cost = std::abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]);
            costs[cost]++;
        }
    }

    int spent = 0;
    int cuts = 0;
    for (const auto& entry : costs) {
        int cost = entry.first;
        int count = entry.second;
        if (spent > b) {
            break;
        }
        if (cost == 0) {
            cuts += count;
            continue;
        }
        int canTake = (b - spent) / cost;
        int take = std::min(count, canTake);
        cuts += take;
        spent += take * cost;
        if (take < count) {
            break;
        }
    }
    std::cout << cuts << std::endl;

    delete[] a;
    return 0;
}
